remarks: Available again starting June 1st - don't miss this peaceful riverfront retreat with private access to the Saugatuck River. This fully furnished rental in desirable South Wilton offers the perfect blend of charm, comfort, and natural beauty. Wake up to stunning river views, unwind on the deck or screened-in porch, and enjoy the soothing sounds of water and wildlife. The main level features a cozy bedroom, full bath, and a family room with gorgeous views-ideal for quiet mornings or casual entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a serene escape with an ensuite bath, walk-in closet, and more water views. A third bedroom, office/den, and additional full bath complete the upper level. The lower level includes a spacious living and dining area, well-equipped kitchen, half bath, and laundry room. With easy access to NYC and just minutes from Westport, Weston, and all that Lower Fairfield County has to offer, this home is available for long-term rental (12-24 months) at the listed price; or as a summer getaway at $12,000/month (June, July, and August). Flexible terms and unfurnished rental may be considered. A rare opportunity - reach out today!
